test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting to the immediate right of D and the immediate left of F. A is sitting to the immediate left of E and the immediate right of F. G is sitting to the immediate right of E and the immediate left of C. Who is sitting at the left end of the line?
solution:
Given, seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order).

B is sitting to the immediate right of D and the immediate left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c63f202f2cd9eaa3fcd51834e7d6b83619e5020ead1570145602b5d04b1a38ba.png] 

A is sitting to the immediate left of E and the immediate right of F.
